verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents an 'API Access & Keys' feature and custom agent skill developer guide, indicating a real API surface, but there is no evidence of a comprehensive OpenAPI/spec or explicit claim that every UI action (workspace management, embedding config, chat widgets, MCP setup, agent flows) is exposed via API — and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec at expected doc paths. missing for 10: OpenAPI/swagger spec, explicit documentation mapping UI features to API endpoints, independent confirmation of full API/UI parity.
